title: NotStampyC's Server Pack
description: This is a mod i made that contains many blocks, items and commands that you might need in a Create Mod Creative Server. (Not Survival Friendly yet)
body:
I made this mod originaly for my Minecraft Create Mod server based in the UK however it has enough features that I think it would be cool for other peoples servers.
This mod adds a wide range of items.

## Items and Blocks

### Transportation
- Money (£)
- Train Travel cards (Free travel for now)
- Train Tickets (1 Journey only) 
- Dispatching Baton (R-Click to change from red to green and back)
- Dispatching Whistles
- Bus Stop (Configure with hammer)
- _Bus Stand_ (Rotate the bottom off a bus stop to get this block)
- Temporary Bus Stop
- Bus Stop Post
- Ticket Gate (Takes either Tickets, Travel cards or Bank cards)

### Banking
- Card Machine (**GUI Temp Disabled**)
- Payment Card Initialiser
- British Money (£)
- Money Gun (Flex your wealth)

### Technology
- Soundboard (Not yet working)
- DeCursifier™ (Removes curses from items)
- Drill (Breaks most blocks instantly but forever)
- Hammer (Config Hammer like the Create Mod Wrench)

### Extras
- Trash Bin
- Trash Block

## Commands

- /maps <mapName> (links to my servers train map, i will make it customisable at some point)
- /clean (clears all ground items)
- /afk (sends a **chat message** to tell people you are afk)
- /t <time=d/n> (/time set day/night but faster to type)
- /head (places an item from main hand on your head)
- /custom inhand rename (renames the item in your hand like if you used an anvil)
- /custom item <type=rename/enchant> (/gives you an item with a custom name or enchants)

## Using the Configs

### Bus Stops
                                                                                                                                  
You are able to customise both the top and bottom to say whatever                                                                                                                                  
It uses text displayys but they dont seem to lag the game that much                                                   
                                                                                                            
- To edit the top, right click it with the hammer
- When the text boxes are filled out, click on Confirm (->) and then Display (O)
- If you want to clear it then press on Clear (X)

- To edit the bottom, right click the bottom with the hammer
- There are 9 text boxes each for a separate bus nuumber
- When the text boxes are filled out, Click on Confirm (->) and then Display (O)
- If you want to clear it then press on Clear (X)

You do not have to fill out all text boxes on there, they default to empty strings.


### Ticket Gates

- To edit the ticket machine, Shift+RightClick with the hammer
- There are 4 values you can change (Owner, oystercard, defaultCost and PAYG)
- Owner allows you to declare ownership so you can take the money out later
- oystercard is a boolean which determines if you can use Oyster cards on the ticket gate
- defaultCost is a boolean that decides whether it should use the default cost or not
- PAYG is the custom cost of the ticket gate passthrough
- if payment is not defined then it defaults to free of charge
- Press Save to save the changes
- The out button is to collect the balance (Doesnt work properly yet)

## Extra info

The hammer has 2 modes (Mode 0 = Config, Mode 1 = Rotate) press c to switch between them.       
In config mode it can **configure any block that supports it**.                                            
In Rotate mode it can **rotate any block along the x axis**.                                     

Some sounds that are being used at the moment are placeholders.                                
The ban hammer and drill both use the mace sounds.
